disclaimer.title: Mental health — our 5th pillar.
disclaimer.intro: Real health is physical AND mental. /mind is your daily mental check-in, your private journal, your sessions library, and your AI coach for the head.
disclaimer.important_body: MakeIt's Mind module is NOT clinical treatment. It's training mental habits — comparable to breathwork, journaling, and reflection. NOT a substitute for therapy or medication. If you're in a bad place, or thinking about harming yourself or others, talk to a real human who can help right now.
disclaimer.resources_doctor: Your doctor or the psychiatric ER
disclaimer.privacy_journal: Munk, coaches and other members cannot read your journal (only you in the app). An excerpt may be sent to Anthropic (Claude) for crisis-text moderation. That is a processor — not a coach.
disclaimer.privacy_mind_check: Your mind-check is private by default. When you tier up, you can choose to share your signal with your buddy. Both must opt in. An optional note may be included in the daily mental coach at Anthropic.
disclaimer.privacy_ai: The AI coach (Anthropic) reads your mind-check including optional note, HRV, and training week — not your journal body — to write you a daily reflection. Output is stored so you can re-read it.
disclaimer.accepted: Thank you — the module is open.

safety.title: We saw something that worries us.
safety.body: You wrote something that sounds like you're having a really hard time right now. You don't need to do anything with us here — the important thing is talking to a person who can help.
safety.doctor: Your doctor or the psychiatric ER
safety.privacy: Your journal entry is saved. Munk and coaches cannot see it. An excerpt may have been sent to Anthropic for moderation — not for coaching.
safety.escalateTitle: Write yourself what you want to share.
safety.escalateBody: Munk sees ONLY what you write here. Never your journal. A strength coach is not a crisis service — Livslinien and 112 are still the right call if it's burning.
safety.escalatePlaceholder: E.g. 'I'm having a hard time right now. Could we talk this week?'
safety.sentBody: Munk can see it when he opens Safety. This is not an emergency alarm, and he does not get a push. If you're in a bad place: Livslinien 70 201 201, 24/7.
safety.sentDemoTitle: In demo mode the message is not saved.
safety.sentDemoBody: There is no real Munk queue here. Livslinien 70 201 201 (24/7) and 112 are the honest next step if it's burning.
safety.errorInvalid: The message could not be sent. Try again.
safety.errorTooShort: Write a little more — at least 4 characters.
safety.errorRls: The message could not be saved. Call Livslinien if you need help now.
safety.errorWrite: The message could not be saved. Try again, or call Livslinien.
safety.errorGeneric: The message could not be saved. Try again, or call Livslinien.
